value.title: Final Frontier
value.synopsis: Welcome to New Earth. Everyone has survived the combination but with some new backstories to guide them. Ayuko has plans to revive the Rara army and intends on Kazuki and Mitsuki 2 to hook up. Meanwhile artifacts have been discovered on the new earth. In the end plans are made to explore space as a resurrected Genbu returns to Kazuki as everyone prepares to venture out on a new adventure.
